conditions: The licensee is conveying a Combined Work under section 4 of the cited LGPL version 3 edition.
limitations: This finding covers section 4(b) and leaves the other section 4 conditions and work-specific applicability for separate assessment.
The claim concerns the documents to include. It does not prescribe filenames or determine the consequences of a later-edition election.

statement: When a licensee conveys a Combined Work under GNU LGPL version 3 section 4, section 4(b) requires copies of the LGPL version 3 document and GNU GPL version 3 to accompany the Combined Work.
